description: FSB - Fiscalização de Segurança de Barragens is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. A fiscalização de Segurança de Barragens realizada pela ANEEL tem como principal objetivo verificar a conformidade da usina hidrelétrica à legislação vigente do setor elétrico, com foco nas condições de segurança de barragens, diques e estruturas associadas, de acordo com o disposto na Lei nº 12.334, de 20 de setembro de 2010, e na Resolução ... Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are Lei 12.334, barragem, fiscalização, risco, segurança barragens. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
